name: Goals
description: Keeps each person's long-running goals and the evidence added to them, private to the owner. A person can list, create, change and close a goal, and add evidence to a goal that is still open. Evidence on a closed goal is refused. Chat tools, the Today section and the screen are not part of this package yet.

settings.label: Goals
settings.description: Goals can be reached through the Goals routes. Goals has no settings page, as before.

features.description: A person can list their goals in priority order, create a goal, change it, and close it by marking it completed or archived. Each person sees only their own goals.

errors.description: The goal does not exist or belongs to another person. Check the goal and try again.
The goal is completed or archived, so new evidence is refused. Reopen the goal to add evidence.

features.description: A person can add evidence to a goal that is still open, with its kind, source and summary. Adding evidence updates the goal's updated time.
